# The Smarter Project

> Smarter is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) platform where an organization's people learn to build AI applications, and then build the real ones, on infrastructure the organization owns and governs. Every AI resource — models and vendors, credentials, data sources, tools, guardrails, budgets, assistants and conversations — is a named, owned, recorded item, declared in a YAML manifest: an ERP for AI resources.

Official website: https://smarter.sh/

## For decision makers

- https://smarter.sh/: what Smarter is, the problem it solves, and a 12-week pilot
- https://smarter.sh/platform: the platform's capabilities
- https://smarter.sh/education: teaching AI with Smarter, and 21 free course designs
- https://smarter.sh/integrations: WordPress, Drupal, Shopify, Google Tag Manager, Docusaurus, MkDocs, Sphinx, VitePress and any web page
- https://smarter.sh/partners: installation, hosting, training and customization partners

## For developers

- https://smarter.sh/sdks: the Python, Node.js and Go SDKs, the CLI and the OpenAPI contract
- https://smarter.sh/extensions: no-code plugins, installable Python extensions and MCP servers
- https://smarter.sh/developers: contributing to Smarter
- https://smarter.sh/cli: download the command-line interface
- https://ubc.smarter.sh/docs/openapi/: the Smarter API's OpenAPI 3.1 document
